About
Incorporated in 1985, Privi Speciality Chemicals Ltd (Formerly known as Privi Speciality Ltd.) is primarily engaged in the manufacturing, supply and exports of aroma and fragrance chemicals used in soaps, detergents, shampoos, and other fine fragrances.
